name: Murmur
author: Erin Carter
description: A single starling murmuration wheels through a near-black dusk — a few hundred countable dots flying as one sinuous body that stretches, necks, and folds back on itself while its leading edge flashes brighter and hue-shifts through the turns.

params.label: Flight speed
params.effect: Travel rate of the flock around the frame — drowsy gliding at min, urgent pre-roost swirling at max.

params.label: Flock size
params.effect: CSS-pixel length of the flock body — a tight distant knot of birds up to a ribbon spanning half the frame.

params.label: Dot size
params.effect: CSS-pixel size of each bird dot — barely-resolvable grains up to plainly countable specks.

params.label: Shapeshift
params.effect: Amplitude of the body's folding and necking — calm steady ribbon at low, dramatic split-and-merge contortions at high.
